value.rationale: Area-averaged injectivity radius is a canonical geometric local-nonambiguity invariant. A sharp theorem over the complete similarity moduli of flat Klein bottles reveals that its unique optimal shape is nonsquare even though the square is the classical sharp systolic metric. This is a structural extremum and clear contrast of natural invariants, not an isolated numerical parameter gain.
